text:
Anya: FYI — nightly perf benchmark for model-large in APAC starts 06:00 SGT tomorrow. Our H100 quota looks short by ~8 cards after the canary. Can someone confirm if we can borrow vendor capacity or use a fallback? cc @Nick (Vendor) :thinking:
Sam: How short exactly? Is this for Dedicated or ephemeral burst?
Anya: Ephemeral burst for the run, needs ~8 H100 (single-card instances ok). Dedicated pools unaffected. Breakdown: expected usage 22 -> available 14.
Kelly: We can use A40s for throughput smoke, but latency-sensitive tails require H100.
Nick (Vendor): We have two racks in ap-southeast-1 with 12 H100 each. We can provision 8 cards for 24h with PO + invoice hold. Lead time 48h unless we do a spot transfer.
Sam: PO turnaround from finance is usually 24–48h. If vendor can shave to 24h we might make it. Billing unit? hourly or daily?
Nick (Vendor): Hourly with 1h min. Need a vendor PO ref; send to vendor@partnermail.com. I can also approve a temp invoice hold for a one-off test — need explicit ok from ops.
Samir: Ops — can we allow temp invoice hold? @Kelly do we have demo/burst budget headroom? :money_with_wings: 
Kelly: I can sign off up to $5k without exec. 8 H100 for 24h ~ est $3.2k. OK from me. Send PO when ready.
Anya: If we go vendor route we'll need to update terraform tenant allocation quickly. PR ready: https://git.redwood.internal/r/redwood/infra/pulls/3456 — snippet:
```
resource "redwood_ephemeral_gpu" "apac_burst" {
  region = "ap-southeast-1"
  sku = "h100"
  count = 8
  duration_hours = 24
}
```
Devops-bot: CI passed for PR #3456 — plan looks clean :white_check_mark:
Sam: @Nick can you provision 8 cards starting 06:00 SGT tomorrow if PO sent now? Also need serials for RDMA testing.
Nick (Vendor): I can provision starting +26h if PO arrives within 2h. Serial list will be attached in the provisioning email. I'll also attach the invoice hold token.
Anya: Great. Action items: Sam to send PO, Nick to provision once PO received, Samir to confirm invoice hold, I'll update the run schedule. Thanks everyone :rocket:
Kelly: Ping me if costs spike — will cover within signoff.
Samir: Invoice hold approved from ops. @Nick forward hold token when ready.
Nick (Vendor): Hold token sent to finance@redwood.com and sam@redwood.com. Provisioning ticket #V-782 opened; ETA note added to the ticket.
Anya: Closing loop — scheduled run moved +2h to accommodate provisioning. Thread resolved for now. :heavy_check_mark:
